surah.personality_summary: Unique Qur'anic surah of 44 ayat revealed in Mecca, possessing its distinct thematic core, atmosphere, and rhetorical progression.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Al-Ma'aarij (The Ascending Stairways) is the 70th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 44 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ سَأَلَ سَائِلٌ بِعَذَابٍ وَاقِعٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم سال سائل بعذاب واقع
ayahs.translation_saheeh: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: A man [mockingly] demanded the punishment

ayahs.translation_saheeh: To the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: It will fall on the disbelievers––none can deflect it––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [It is] from Allah, owner of the ways of ascent
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: from God, the Lord of the Ways of Ascent

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: تَعۡرُجُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيۡهِ فِي يَوۡمࣲ كَانَ مِقۡدَارُهُۥ خَمۡسِينَ أَلۡفَ سَنَةࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: تَعْرُجُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِي يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: تعرج الملائكة والروح اليه في يوم كان مقداره خمسين الف سنة
ayahs.translation_saheeh: The angels and the Spirit will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: by which the angels and the Spirit ascend to Him, on a Day whose length is fifty thousand years

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So be patient with gracious patience
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: So be patient, [Prophet], as befits you

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, they see it [as] distant
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The disbelievers think it is distant

ayahs.translation_saheeh: But We see it [as] near
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but We know it to be close

ayahs.translation_saheeh: On the Day the sky will be like murky oil
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: On a Day when the heavens will be like molten brass

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the mountains will be like wool
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and the mountains like tufts of wool

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And no friend will ask [anything of] a friend
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when no friend will ask about his friend

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمۡۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُ لَوۡ يَفۡتَدِي مِنۡ عَذَابِ يَوۡمِئِذِۭ بِبَنِيهِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ الْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِي مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍ بِبَنِيهِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: يبصرونهم ۚ يود المجرم لو يفتدي من عذاب يومئذ ببنيه
ayahs.translation_saheeh: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: even when they are within sight of one another. The guilty person will wish he could save himself from the suffering of that Day by sacrificing his sons

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And his wife and his brother
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: his spouse, his brother

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And his nearest kindred who shelter him
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: the kinsfolk who gave him shelter

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعࣰ ا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يُنْجِيهِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ومن في الارض جميعا ثم ينجيه
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and everyone on earth, if it could save him

ayahs.translation_saheeh: No! Indeed, it is the Flame [of Hell]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: But no! There is a raging flame

ayahs.translation_saheeh: A remover of exteriors
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: that strips away the skin

ayahs.translation_saheeh: It invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and it will claim everyone who rejects the truth, turns away

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And collected [wealth] and hoarded
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: amasses wealth and hoards it

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, mankind was created anxious
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Man was truly created anxious

ayahs.translation_saheeh: When evil touches him, impatient
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: he is fretful when misfortune touches him

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when good touches him, withholding [of it]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but tight-fisted when good fortune comes his way

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Except the observers of prayer
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Not so those who pray

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Those who are constant in their prayer
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and are constant in their prayers

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And those within whose wealth is a known right
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: who give a due share of their wealth

ayahs.translation_saheeh: For the petitioner and the deprived
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: to beggars and the deprived

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: who believe in the Day of Judgement

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنۡ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشۡفِقُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ مِنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِمْ مُشْفِقُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: والذين هم من عذاب ربهم مشفقون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and fear the punishment of their Lord––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: none may feel wholly secure from it––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And those who guard their private parts
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: who guard their chastity

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزۡوَٰجِهِمۡ أَوۡ مَا مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُهُمۡ فَإِنَّهُمۡ غَيۡرُ مَلُومِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِلَّا عَلَىٰ أَزْوَاجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: الا على ازواجهم او ما ملكت ايمانهم فانهم غير ملومين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they are not to be blamed
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: from all but their spouses or their slave-girls––there is no blame attached to [relations with] these

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَمَنِ ٱبۡتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡعَادُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَمَنِ ابْتَغَىٰ وَرَاءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْعَادُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فمن ابتغى وراء ذلك فاولئك هم العادون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but those whose desires exceed this limit are truly transgressors––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: who are faithful to their trusts and their pledges

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And those who are in their testimonies upright
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: who give honest testimony

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And those who [carefully] maintain their prayer
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and are steadfast in their prayers

ayahs.translation_saheeh: They will be in gardens, honored
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They will be honoured in Gardens of bliss

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [O Muhammad]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: What is wrong with the disbelievers? Why do they rush to peer at you [Prophet]

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [To sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: from right and left, in crowds

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَيَطۡمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيࣲٕ مِّنۡهُمۡ أَن يُدۡخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ مِنْهُمْ أَنْ يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ايطمع كل امرئ منهم ان يدخل جنة نعيم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Does every one of them expect to enter a Garden of bliss

ayahs.translation_saheeh: No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: No! We created them from the substance they know

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلۡمَشَٰرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغَٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَٰدِرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ الْمَشَارِقِ وَالْمَغَارِبِ إِنَّا لَقَادِرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فلا اقسم برب المشارق والمغارب انا لقادرون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings that indeed We are able
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and, by the Lord of every sunrise and sunset, We have the power

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيۡرࣰ ا مِّنۡهُمۡ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَسۡبُوقِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: عَلَىٰ أَنْ نُبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: على ان نبدل خيرا منهم وما نحن بمسبوقين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: to substitute for them others better than they are- nothing can prevent Us from doing this

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَذَرۡهُمۡ يَخُوضُواْ وَيَلۡعَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا وَيَلْعَبُوا حَتَّىٰ يُلَاقُوا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فذرهم يخوضوا ويلعبوا حتى يلاقوا يومهم الذي يوعدون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: So leave them to wallow in idle talk, until they come face to face with their promised Day

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَوۡمَ يَخۡرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ سِرَاعࣰ ا كَأَنَّهُمۡ إِلَىٰ نُصُبࣲ يُوفِضُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ الْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: يوم يخرجون من الاجداث سراعا كانهم الى نصب يوفضون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: the Day they will rush out of their graves as if rallying to a flag

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: خَٰشِعَةً أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ تَرۡهَقُهُمۡ ذِلَّةࣱۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلَّذِي كَانُواْ يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: خَاشِعَةً أَبْصَارُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ الْيَوْمُ الَّذِي كَانُوا يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: خاشعة ابصارهم ترهقهم ذلة ۚ ذلك اليوم الذي كانوا يوعدون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: eyes downcast and covered in shame: that is the Day of which they were warned
